title: Chroma: The Last Unicorn — My JS13K Journey
subtitle: Telling a story of grief, imagination, and procedural beauty in <13KB for JS13k Games.
author: Nithin Steven
summary: I always wanted to try the JS13k challenge... Now I am so happy to finish it! Here is the story, procedural grass strategies, and sub-13KB engineering behind Chroma: The Last Unicorn.
excerpt: We walk into a dream of a developer who lost his wife in an accident by the cliff. Maya guides him in a dream, letting him bring back the colors from the rainbow to his life and see colors again.

title: Crafting 140 FPS Atmospheric Day-Night Cycles in WebXR
subtitle: Optimizing volumetric skyboxes, ambient lighting, and particle systems for mobile VR headsets.
author: Nithin Steven
summary: Who needs heavyweight real-time baked lighting when custom procedural vertex & fragment shaders can achieve 140 FPS in standalone headsets? Here is our approach to zero-lag WebXR atmospheres.
excerpt: Lighting in standalone VR is notorious for consuming draw calls and fill rate. By moving atmosphere calculations into mathematical ray-scatter approximations in GLSL, we keep peak 120-140 FPS.

title: The Speedcuber's Brain: Pattern Recognition & Algorithmic Reflexes
subtitle: How solving the Rubik's Cube under 10 seconds trains your mental muscle memory and problem-solving intuition.
author: Nithin Steven
summary: From CFOP cross lookaheads to full OLL/PLL muscle memory, explore how speedcubing develops lightning-fast spatial orientation and split-second decision making.
excerpt: Speedcubing isn't about calculating 20 moves ahead on a board—it is about high-speed pattern chunking and tactile feedback loops executing within 400 milliseconds.
